reuse.why: Builds on recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, skipsWeekendOccurrences and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, the same shared helpers getUpcomingDates uses, but does not extract the occurrence-to-final-day step it shares with getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The 'drop weekend days if daily, else move with getDateWithSkippedWeekend' dispatch is restated from getUpcomingDates rather than shared.

placement.why: New handler sits next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, commented window widening and dedupe with good tests; a future weekend-rule change must be mirrored in two handlers' dispatch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend moves and the daily-skip predicate go through the shared helpers in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange's per-occurrence 'continue if dropsWeekendDays && isWeekend, else getDateWithSkippedWeekend' loop is getUpcomingDates' filter/map ternary reshaped into a loop.
